subject: Your partner's 3 ignored invitations
preview_text: The one feature that turns quiet hints into unforgettable nights. See what you've been missing.
body_paragraphs: She said 'Wanna do something tonight?' three times last month. You said 'sure' twice and 'maybe tomorrow' once. She stopped asking. That silence isn't peace—it's the sound of routine winning.

Here's the hack: open the app, tap the Wishlist tab. Scroll through the dates she's saved but never sent. Pick the one with the most hearts. Then hit 'Send to Partner'. That's it. She gets a full-screen 'thought of you tonight' moment. No planning. No fatigue. Just the spark.

Couples who use the Wishlist this way—sending a saved idea instead of asking 'what do you want?'—plan 4x more dates in the next month. Because when one partner feels invisible, a single gesture says 'I see you' louder than a thousand texts.

Open SoulPlan: Plan Dates Together now. Tap Wishlist. Send her the date she's been waiting for. P.S. Tomorrow morning, check the Memory Timeline. That saved date? It'll be the first photo in your new scrapbook.
